banner.title: volsync
banner.tagline: Retired: the VolSync operator is gone, and this Flux Kustomization keeps the Ceph bucket that holds 30 of 51 retired restic repositories.
banner.status: RETIRED • system/volsync KEPT FOR ITS CEPH BUCKET

art.about: a retired backup bucket that is kept on purpose
art.title: What the retired VolSync bucket holds

explainer.title: One bucket, kept on purpose, with its prune switched off

steps.title: Keep
steps.text: Flux Kustomization volsync renders only backend/. Its name is part of the guard: a rename or re-path lets prune delete the Ceph bucket's contents.
steps.scene: an archive box held shut with a padlock

steps.title: Bucket
steps.text: ObjectBucketClaim volsync on storage class ceph-bucket owns bucket volsync. Its reclaim policy is Delete, and prune is disabled on the claim.
steps.scene: a database cylinder behind a gate

steps.title: User
steps.text: CephObjectStoreUser volsync owns the bucket, with a 20G quota. Its prune is also disabled, and Git keeps it until expiry has run.
steps.scene: a user badge clipped to a key ring

steps.title: Keys
steps.text: The PushSecret copies the bucket's access keys to 1Password item volsync-template, which also holds the repository passwords.
steps.scene: a sealed envelope leaving a vault

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Expiry of the retired repositories is not in force. Nothing here removes one. MinIO and R2 hold the other 21 and are not guarded by this Kustomization.
steps.scene: a clock frozen over a stack of repositories
